title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Despite Shanmugam's opposition, Vetri remains outside to protect Abinaya and her family. Karna's men attack Shanmugam when he confronts Karna over Abinaya's ordeal.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Furious over misbehaving with Poongodi, Sudalai and Manjamalai target Pandian. Later, Meenatchi scolds Poongodi for insulting Mayandi, as Mohana stirs the pot.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj manipulates Dharani to bring Revathi home. Expressing his pain over their separation, he pleads with her to return and offers to register a property in her name.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian shows his will, granting Palanivel a share of his property when Sakthivel questions his support. Touched by his gesture, Palanivel decides to return to Pandian's home.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Cheran Steps Up for the Engagement
description: Cheran shocks the family by giving Nila money to purchase Chandrayatha's engagement ring. Chozhan urges Nila to invite her parents to Cheran's engagement.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam grants Aishwarya a lifetime wish, while her parents pray for her happy family life with Sethupathi. Grateful for saving Meenatchi, Sethupathi vows to care for her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan surprises Indhira with a unique fire-roasted coconut dish as a special engagement gift. Kandhasamy praises Murugan's culinary effort after tasting the dish.
